 * IMPORTANT ALERT *
    All units to publish officers Part II Orders through HRMS forthwith.
  	As per ADG of Manpower (P & P) order dt 19 Sep 2019, any Part II Order published  manually by units will NOT be 
   accepted this month onwards. All  units are required  to  publish Part II  Orders  in r/o offrs  through  HRMS only and 
   upload the XML files on OASIS  wherever ADN connectivity exists and units not having access to ADN connectivity
   can send the XML files in CD alongwith Part II Orders to Part II Order Cell, AG/MP 5&6. Hard copy of Part II Orders
   will continue to be sent to all addressees as per existing orders  till further orders.  All  units are requested to switch
   over to  publication of  offrs Part II Orders through  HRMS forthwith. Tutorial regarding  uploading of  XML of Part II 
   has been  uploaded  on Home Page of  OASIS "Help desk-Part II Order Upload (Offrs only)".
   HEADLINES  
  (Please visit our website https://pcdaopune.gov.in  for details.)
 * Pay Slips, DSOP Fund Annual Statements  and  Form-16  are now available on your  nic/gov.in  email as well 
 as on OASIS App on ADN and ARMAAN Mobile App.
 * Processing of all dues  of retiring officers  is now being  completed well ahead of their  date of retirement  and
 the status intimated to them through D.O. letters alongwith a copy of their PPOs.
 * D.O. letters are being sent to newly commissioned officers, containing details about opening of their accounts
 in PCDA(O).
 * Information regarding  implementaion of  MoD  orders on restoration of  ration in kind in lieu  of Ration Money 
 Allowance to  Officers posted in  Peace  Areas and  clarifications  thereto are  available on PCDA(O) website.
 * Provisions for drawal of advance/withdrawals from  DSOP Fund by the subscribers liberalized.
 * Pay revision on account of  bunching of pay  stages is being implemented in phases in Pay Slips of Dec 2019
 onwards.
 * Advisory to Officers on rejection of payment by Bankers.
 If you see change in your CDA A/c Number ....
    CDA A/C No.is alloted to all officers in the format NN/NNN/NNNNNNA (N stands for Number, A stands for Alphabet.)  
The  first  five  digits  at the  begining of  this  number  i.e.  NN/NNN  are  subject  to  CHANGE  when our internal  task  
distribution  is changed in  Ledger Wing.You  need not worry  about  such  change. The last six  digits along with check     
alpha   i.e.   NNNNNNA    is  the  number  which  will   REMAIN  FIXED THROUGHOUT  THE SERVICE  of an  officer.  
PLEASE  QUOTE  CORRECT  CDA  ACCOUNT  NUMBER  IN  ALL CORRESPONDENCE  TO  AVOID  DELAY  IN 
RESPONSE.
